summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing a series of Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns and its Monthly Return of Equity Issuer for September 2026. The disclosures report routine share-count mechanics, including 107,360 shares repurchased for cancellation at USD 2.2057, with issued shares held at 1,214,041,449. No transaction, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory clock is stated. Routine buyback and share-movement reporting only; no risk-arb or special-situation angle exists.
